signal: Strictly positive close[t]/close[t-20]-1, using exactly 21 consecutive UTC sessions through Sunday; equality means cash.
accounts: Independent hypothetical accounts; start cash, whole-study carry. Restore target on positive Mondays, drift otherwise. Comparison sleeve invests its entire spendable cash when positive, inactive reserve never transferred. Zero cash interest. Existing post-cost target equation at unadjusted reference rate.

costs.interpretation: Illustrative proportional frictions per actual paper adjustment.

source: Coin Metrics Community BTC USD Reference Rates and PriceUSD. Multi-market USD fixing, including warmup from daily PriceUSD; differs from retrospective Bitstamp trade-bearing minute proxy. No actual execution.
decision_window_utc: Monday 00:00 inclusive to 00:35 exclusive, after receipt of all completed closes. Nominal scheduled start 00:07. Durable public decision required.
fill_window_utc: Monday 00:45:00 UTC reference fixing; state must have been witnessed on origin before this instant; accept a receipt no more than five minutes later. Late/missing decision or fixing preserves accounts.
valuation: Daily UTC closing reference rate at next midnight. Attempt first available daily marks job, nominal 03:17. Receipt after 6 hours is labelled recovered; maximum 48 hours after fixing. Missing remains unknown.
corrections: Retain first accepted values; compare subsequent signal inputs with previously accepted daily marks. Append observed revisions, never substitute them in prior records. No retrospective fill.
primary: Sizing-control minus target maximum drawdown in percentage points, peak initialized at total starting wealth, using every daily close through the last Sunday. Missing even one required mark withholds the endpoint.
secondary: Ending wealth, cumulative fees/slippage and fill counts; initial post-cost BTC weights. Descriptive during collection, uninformative decline possible. No fitted parameters or interim rule changes.
suspension: Stop new observations on registration or journal integrity failure, unavailable permitted public source, change of source/license or loss of free public standard runner. Preserve original evidence and number of missed slots. No substitute source or extension. An owner can disable for integrity, licensing or budget; document reason and mark incomplete.
analysis: Fixed closeout at 2027-12-01T03:00:00Z, after final close and bounded recovery window; first scheduled reconciliation on or after this instant closes the ledger. End date does not move.
